scope: Standalone whole-scene gym template; individual asset node/triangle limits do not apply.

tool.name: Khronos glTF Validator
tool.execution: validateBytes on the actual saved gym.glb bytes

structure.dimensionStatus: Photo-based concept coordinates; no on-site measurements or capacity verification.

geometryDecoding.observed: Integer vertex attributes are read using Three.js getX/getY/getZ/getW and written as Float32BufferAttribute. Normalized accessors are decoded before export; original indices and node/world transforms are retained. Actual exported vertex attributes are all FLOAT (5126).

instanceExpansion.observed: Instances are expanded into ordinary Mesh objects using source.matrixWorld multiplied by the instance matrix; furniture and all 100 participant nodes are retained.

extraFlowWalkers.observed: Original buildFlows creates 8 walkers in renderer.flowGroup. collect skips the entire flowGroup and asserts exactly one group was excluded.

backgroundPlane.observed: Original ground is PlaneGeometry(300,300). Exporter excludes that exact background geometry and asserts one exclusion; coordinates are a photo-based concept.

roofMaterial.observed: Only renderer.roofMaterial is copied with opacity 0.94. Exported roof subtree contains that material and contains no 0.13-opacity material.

limits: This validates the saved GLB container and scene structure, not surveyed venue dimensions, legal occupancy, crowd simulation, or visual quality.
Source-exclusion checks combine independently inspected source code with exported participant counts; exporter statistics are not used as the sole proof.
